### Our CRM mission statement

Pipedrive is the easy and effective CRM for small and medium-sized companies.

We empower SMBs to unlock their business potential and scale with our easy-to-use, affordable and effective CRM.

With Pipedrive, you can track your sales pipeline, manage leads and automate your entire sales process from one central place – so you can focus on selling. Stay organized, productive and efficient, with access to multiple integrations, automation, reporting, dashboards and more.
